description.value: A small three-site managed campsite near Nanaimo, positioned beside a river; no amenities are confirmed so arrive self-sufficient.

address.value: 4 F Br Rd, Nanaimo Lakes, BC V9R 1L5, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Riverside is an active campsite on Mosaic Forest Management land near Nanaimo Lakes, with a 2026 season listed (April 1–October 13) and an online booking system. The site description explicitly mentions an outhouse and online reservations. OSM capacity tag (3) conflicts with the website's stated 6 camping units — the website is preferred. No phone or physical address appears in OSM or on the website.
concerns: OSM capacity tag is '3' but the website states the site includes 6 camping units — website value preferred.
This is a dedicated group site; the entire site must be booked as a unit, which is unsuitable for individual or paired touring cyclists.
Site is approximately 35 minutes from all services in Nanaimo via a forest service road — very remote access.
No phone number or physical address available in OSM or on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational campsite with an active 2026 season and online booking. Accessible to the public and accepts tents, making it potentially useful to touring cyclists travelling in groups.
enrichment_extras.notes: Firewood may be sold by the Windy Point host when campfires are permitted. The entrance driveway is described as slightly steep. Off-season group rentals of the broader campground network are available via campsites@silvifor.com, but Riverside is not listed among off-season options.
